summary: Backend-only test of /api/fix-files/* endpoints and enriched interview contracts. 22/24 tests passed. The 2 failures are false-positives (openapi.json is served at /openapi.json, not /api/openapi.json under the ingress). All 20 whitelisted fix-file endpoints return HTTP 200; app.json returns expo.version=1.0.5 & versionCode=6; sync-ui-fix.ps1 has UTF-8 BOM + 0 non-ASCII body bytes; withAndroidBuildFixes.js contains 'windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode'; unknown file returns 404 with JSON detail. Live LLM calls for /api/ai/interview/evaluate and /api/ai/interview/live both succeeded and returned the new enriched fields (strengths/improvements/example and strong_points respectively) confirming the contract.

minor.issue: OpenAPI schema not exposed under /api/ prefix (served at root /openapi.json instead). Non-blocking — runtime contract is verified by live LLM calls. If schema-via-ingress is desired, add a proxy route.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py FIX_FILES dict actually contains 20 entries (18 mentioned in task + fix-overlap-and-build.ps1 + push-ota-update.ps1). All are reachable and function. Consider documenting the extra 2 in the task description or removing them if unintended.
get_fix_file uses synchronous path.read_text inside an async endpoint — acceptable for tiny source files but consider aiofiles for larger payloads.
No caching/ETag on /api/fix-files/{name}; every PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest re-reads the file. Fine at current scale.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 substantive tests; 2 openapi-location assertions are non-issues)
